capabilities: Open a random note from the current search results
Open a random note that has a selected tag
Insert a link at the cursor to a random note from search
Open a random note from all notes like the core command
extras: The author deliberately declined to add spaced repetition, pointing readers to the Flashcards, Spaced Repetition, and Recall plugins instead. Compatibility notes target old Obsidian API versions (0.9.x).
intentEvidence: This plugin enhances opening random notes.
problem: Obsidian's core Random note feature only opens a note from the entire vault, with no way to draw from search results or notes with a specific tag.
summary: Random note opener with more control: pick a random note from search results or by tag, insert a random-note link at the cursor, or open from the whole vault.
